On the bed are three dogs:

Mama Sharito: a white female chihuahua with delicate angel wings and a glowing halo, serene and graceful.

Ivisito: a small male chihuahua with light brown fur, tongue out playfully, full of energy.

Fifi le Fofoo: a fluffy white female maltese, slightly tousled, with tongue out and a pink bow.

The background includes soft daylight from a window, two articulated silver desk lamps, a sleek keyboard and trackpad. The scene is rendered in 8K, hyperrealistic texture, cinematic quality, soft shadows and high-gloss polish. No logos or copyrighted characters.
